rules.name: Two-handed Melee Weapons
rules.description: A fighter can be equipped with a *held item* and a *two-handed* melee weapon (eg. a Spear and Shield), however, subtract 1 from the Attacks value of the fighter's *two-handed* melee weapons.

rules.name: Two-handed Ranged Weapons
rules.description: A fighter cannot be equipped with a *held item* and a *two-handed* ranged weapon.

categoryEntries.name: Can be equipped with a BPP
Can be equipped with a Ranged Weapon

sharedRules.name: Arcane
sharedRules.description:
*(Critical hits on 5+)*
Attack rolls made with this weapon score critical hits on a natural roll of 5 or 6.

sharedRules.name: Blast
sharedRules.description:
*(Blast template. Miss scatters d6x2")*
This weapon uses the Blast template.

sharedRules.name: Bludgeon
sharedRules.description:
*(Critical hits deal 1 damage when saved)*
Each time an armour roll successfully saves a critical hit scored by this weapon, the target suffers 1 damage.

sharedRules.name: Brace
sharedRules.description:
*(Initiative vs charging fighters)*
If a fighter uses this weapon while they are the defending fighter, they automatically have the initiative if the attacking fighter charged this activation.

sharedRules.name: Flame
sharedRules.description:
*(Flame template. Auto-hits)*
This weapon uses the Flame template.

sharedRules.name: Guard
sharedRules.description:
*(1 miss can parry a hit)*
When a fighter makes a parry, instead of using a hit they can use a missed attack roll from this weapon. They can do this once each melee attack.

sharedRules.name: Heavy
sharedRules.description:
*(Move or Attack)*
This weapon cannot be used to make an attack if the fighter has made a move during the same activation. In addition, if this weapon has been used to make an attack, the fighter cannot make a move in that same activation.

sharedRules.name: Misfire
sharedRules.description:
*(On a natural 1)*
If any attack rolls for a ranged attack made with this weapon are a natural 1, the weapon misfires. After any other attack rolls have been resolved, make a misfire roll on the table below:
|d6|Misfire Roll|
|:---:|:----|
|1|**Backfire**: The fighter suffers d3 damage. This weapon cannot be used again during this battle.|
|2|**Clogged**: This weapon cannot be used again during this battle.|
|3-6|**Flash-in-the-Pan**: The attack misses as normal.|

sharedRules.name: Natural Weapon
sharedRules.description:
*(Cannot parry)*
Attacks made with this weapon cannot be used to parry.

sharedRules.name: Off-hand
sharedRules.description:
*(Can be used off-hand: 1 attack)*
When making a melee attack, this weapon can be used to make an off-hand attack.

sharedRules.name: One-use
sharedRules.description:
*(1 attack per battle)*
This weapon can only be used once each battle.

sharedRules.name: Poison
sharedRules.description:
*(Critical hits poison. Suffer 1 damage when activated. Until healed or 1 life remains)*
If a fighter suffers damage from a critical hit made with this weapon they become *poisoned*. While a fighter is *poisoned*, each time they are activated they suffer 1 damage. If a fighter is healed, or has 1 life remaining, they are no longer poisoned.
*Demons* and *Undead* fighters cannot become poisoned.

sharedRules.name: Rare (0-[x])
sharedRules.description:
*(Limited by the number listed)*
This trait limits the number of fighters in a warband that can be equipped with this type of weapon at the same time. For example, if a weapon has the Rare 0-1 trait, only 1 fighter in a warband can be equipped with a weapon of this type at any one time.

sharedRules.name: Reload
sharedRules.description:
*(Forgo a Move or Action to reload)*
This weapon begins the battle **loaded**. Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, before it can be used again, the fighter must **reload** it. To reload a weapon, the fighter must forgo either their Move or their Action during their activation. A fighter cannot reload a weapon while engaged in melee.

sharedRules.name: Two-handed
sharedRules.description:
*(1 per fighter. No off-hand attack)*
A fighter can only be equipped with 1 two-handed weapon.
A fighter cannot make off-hand attacks if they are equipped with a two-handed weapon.

sharedRules.name: Unwieldy
sharedRules.description:
*(-1 to attack rolls)*
Subtract 1 from attack rolls made with this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Volley
sharedRules.description:
*(Multiple targets within 3")*
Each time this weapon is used for a ranged attack, it can target a number of enemy fighters equal to its Attacks value. Before resolving any attack rolls, assign each attack to a target. The first target must be picked as normal, each additional attack can be assigned to that target, or to a different visible enemy fighter within 3" of the target that is not engaged in melee.
Then resolve all the attacks.

sharedRules.name: Wrap
sharedRules.description:
*(Cannot parry or be parried)*
Attacks made by this weapon cannot be parried, and they cannot be used to parry another attack.

sharedRules.name: Scare
sharedRules.description:
*(Unengaged fighters pass Willpower test or scatter d6")*
After an attack by this weapon has been resolved, each fighter hit by the attack that is not engaged in melee takes a Willpower test. If they fail, they scatter d6".

sharedRules.name: Duellist
sharedRules.description: This fighter can parry critical hits with any successful attack.

sharedRules.name: Sniff 'em Out
sharedRules.description: Enemy fighters that are hidden are not hidden while they are within 9" of this fighter.

sharedRules.name: Seasoned Warrior
sharedRules.description: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

sharedRules.name: Unshakeable
sharedRules.description: This fighter ignores the *Fear* special rule and all rules that would make them scatter (eg. the *Scare* weapon trait).

sharedRules.name: Drink Unclean Waters
sharedRules.description: Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, a fighter can drink from the well. If they do so, you can remove 1 of their **temporary injuries**, but they gain 1 level of Black Rot.

sharedRules.name: Spy the City
sharedRules.description: This holding grants 1 **exploration re-roll** when the controlling warband explores the City.

sharedRules.name: Useless
sharedRules.description: This item has no use except to be sold.

sharedRules.name: Polearm
sharedRules.description:
*(Can be equipped with a Held Item, gains Unwieldy)*
Fighters equipped with this weapon can still be equipped with Held Items (eg. Shields). If they do so, this weapon gains the *Unwieldy* weapon trait.

rules.name: Cuirass
rules.description: *Armour value 5+*

rules.name: Warded Robes
rules.description:
*Armour value 6+*
Roll a dice each time a fighter equipped with this armour is targeted by a spell cast by an enemy fighter. On a 4+, the spell has no effect on this fighter.

rules.name: Full-plate
rules.description:
*Armour value 4+*
Fighters equipped with this armour cannot be equipped with twohanded ranged weapons with the exception of a Brace of Pistols.

rules.name: Shield
rules.description: Improve this fighter's Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).

rules.name: Grimoire
rules.description: Once per battle, after this fighter has made casting roll, you can re-roll the casting roll.

rules.name: Dual-weapon Wielder
rules.description: Each time this fighter attacks with an off-hand weapon, they can make 2 attacks with that weapon instead of 1.

rules.name: Fast Learner
rules.description: In the aftermath sequence of each battle, this fighter earns d6 bonus experience.

rules.name: Great Weapon Master
rules.description: This fighter ignores the ‘Unwieldy’ weapon trait on Melee Weapons.

rules.name: Shooting Drills
rules.description: Each time this fighter reloads a weapon, they can make a Willpower test. If they pass, they do not need to forgo a Move or Action, (see Reload weapon trait).

rules.name: Steady Aim
rules.description: Add 1 to attack rolls for ranged attacks made by this fighter, while this fighter has not moved in the same activation.

rules.name: Tough Bastard
rules.description: Each time this fighter activates while they are **bloodied**, they can take a Willpower test. If they pass, they heal 1 life point and are no longer bloodied.

rules.name: Unshakeable
rules.description: This fighter ignores the Fear special rule and all rules that would make them scatter (eg. the Scare weapon trait).

rules.name: Grappling Hook
rules.description: This fighter can climb high walls in the same manner as ladders.

rules.name: Ensorcelled Bell
rules.description: Once per battle, you can re-roll a **miscast roll** made for this fighter.

rules.name: Drink Pure Waters
rules.description: Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, a fighter can drink from the well. If they do so, you can remove 1 of their **temporary injuries**.

rules.name: The Water Blackens
rules.description: If the income roll for this territory is a triple (eg. a 3d6 roll of 4, 4, 4), after the income is collected, this holding becomes a *Tainted Well*.

characteristics.name: Ransack
characteristics.$text: 2d6x5. In addition, roll once on the **Curiosities table**.

characteristics.name: Ransack
characteristics.$text:
2d6x5 silver. In addition, roll once on the table below:
|d6|Burnt Down Smithy|
|---|:--|
|1-2|**Pile of Daggers**: Add d3 Daggers to your stash.|
|3-4|**Shield Rack**: Add d3 Shields to your stash.|
|5-6|**Wall of Swords**: Add d3 Swords to your stash.|

rules.name: Drink Deep
rules.description: When you ransack this holding, every fighter in your warband earns 5 bonus experience.

rules.name: Run Dry
rules.description: If the d6 roll to determine the income is a 1, the supply of eels runs out. After the income is collected, this holding becomes a *Ruined Hovel*.

rules.name: Depleted
rules.description: If the d6 roll to determine the income is a 1, the remaining tunnels are exhausted. After the income is collected, this holding is removed.

rules.name: Fresh from the Canals
rules.description: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive 1 Jar of Canal Leeches.

rules.name: Grave Digging
rules.description: Each time you collect income from this holding, if you roll one or more 6's you can roll on the Curiosity Table.

rules.name: Apothecary's Wares
rules.description: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive 1 Healing Tonic.

rules.name: "Going, Going, Gone"
rules.description: Whenever you sell a *Curiosity* you receive an additional d6 silver. Whenever you sell a *Relic* you receive an additional 2d6 silver.

rules.name: Alchemist's Wares
rules.description:
Each time you collect income from this holding, roll a dice on the table below:
|d6|Insidious Alchemist|
|---|:--|
|1|You receive nothing extra|
|2|You receive 1 Tonic of Speed|
|3|You receive 1 Tonic of Strength|
|4|You receive 1 Tonic of Fortitude |
|5|You receive 1 Blinding Powder|
|6|You receive 1 Alchemist's Fire|

rules.name: Arrival by Tunnel
rules.description: Once per battle, when a fighter from the warband that controls this holding gets the Outflank result on the reinforcement table, they can emerge from the tunnels. If they do so, set up the fighter anywhere on the battlefield floor, more than 6" from all enemy fighters.

rules.name: Poisonous Wares
rules.description: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive d3 Vials of Poison.

rules.name: Discovered
rules.description: If the income roll for this territory is a double (eg. a 2d6 roll of 4 and 4), after the income is collected, this holding becomes a Ruined Hovel.

rules.name: Curious Wares
rules.description: Each time you collect income from this holding, you can roll once on the Curiosity Table.

rules.name: Hiring Workers
rules.description: You cannot collect income from this territory until you have hired workers. Hiring workers costs 10 silver and is done once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence. Once workers are hired, income can be collected from the following aftermath sequence onwards. Make a note on your warband roster. If another warband gains control of this holding, the workers need to be hired once more.

rules.name: Collapse
rules.description: If the income roll for this territory is a triple (eg. a 3d6 roll of 4, 4, 4), after the income is collected, this holding becomes a Collapsed Mine.

rules.name: The Trials of the Tower
rules.description:
When a warband first takes control of this holding, it has **3 wards** remaining. During the campaign, keep track of how many wards remain on this holding, including if another warband takes control of this holding.
Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, the warband that controls this holding can send its Leader or a Champion to attempt to bypass a ward. If they do so, make a Willpower test for that fighter. If passed, 1 ward is removed from the holding. If failed, make an **injury roll** for the fighter.
When all wards have been removed, the warband that controls this holding claims its treasure. They roll once on the Relic table. Then, this Holding becomes a *Ruined Tower*.

rules.name: Burden of Command
rules.description: This fighter earns d6 bonus experience in step 3 of the aftermath sequence.

rules.name: Saint Trickster's Charm
rules.description: At the end of this fighter's activation, if they do not hold treasure and are engaged in melee with an enemy fighter that does, you can roll a dice. On a 4+, that enemy fighter is no longer holding that treasure, this fighter is holding it instead.

rules.name: Enchanted Coin Purse
rules.description: In step 3 of the Aftermath sequence, if this fighter took part in the battle, their warband earns an additional **2d6 silver**.

rules.name: Von Zikmund Pocketwatch
rules.description: You can re-roll reinforcement rolls made for this fighter.

rules.name: Ring of Roses
rules.description: This fighter cannot be Poisoned. In addition, in step 7 of each aftermath sequence, you can remove 1 level of Black Rot from this fighter.

rules.name: Pilgrim's Eye
rules.description:
This item grants 1 exploration re-roll (tens dice only) if this fighter is included in the scouting party.
If the re-rolled dice is a 1, the item shatters.

rules.name: Saint Restoria's Charm
rules.description:
Once per battle, while this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Hold Charm [Bonus Action]**: Heal this fighter d6 life.

rules.name: Tonic of Fortitude
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]**: For the rest of the battle, improve this fighter's Armour value by 1.

rules.name: Tonic of Levitation
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]**: This fighter can fly.
At the start of each of this fighter's subsequent activations, roll a dice. On a 1-3, the effect ends. On a 4+ the effect continues.

rules.name: Tonic of Mind
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]**: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to this fighter's Initiative and Willpower values.

rules.name: Tonic of Speed
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]**: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to this fighter's Move value.

rules.name: Tonic of Steady Aim
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]**: For the rest of the battle, improve this fighter's Bow value by 1.

rules.name: Tonic of Strength
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]**: For the rest of the battle, improve this fighter's Blade value by 1.

rules.name: Deepwood Boots
rules.description: Add 1" to this fighter's Move value.

rules.name: Saint Fortuna's Charm
rules.description: Each time this fighter makes a ranged attack or a melee attack, you can re-roll 1 attack dice.

rules.name: Banner of Lost Souls
rules.description: **[Action]** Once per battle, while the bearer is not engaged in melee, they can use this held item as an action. If they do so, roll a dice. On a 1, nothing happens. On a 2+, pick a friendly fighter that is taken down. Set up that friendly fighter within 1" of this fighter, not engaged in melee. That fighter is healed d3 life.

rules.name: Golden Newt
rules.description:
Only *Wizards* and *Priests* can be equipped with this item.
Once per battle, when this fighter makes an Arcane Action to Cast a Spell, they can use the Golden Newt. If they do so, they are considered to have drawn power.

rules.name: Shield of Thorns
rules.description:
Improve this fighter's Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).
In addition, each time this fighter makes an armour roll of a natural 6 against a melee attack, the attacking fighter suffers 1 damage.

rules.name: Iron Ward
rules.description: Add 1 to the fighter's Armour value (to a maximum of 2+).

rules.name: Heirloom Duelling Pistol
rules.description: Any fighter that can be equipped with a blackpowder pistol can be equipped with an Heirloom Duelling Pistol.

rules.name: Poison Quiver & Bow
rules.description: Any fighter that can be equipped with a ranged weapon (they have access to one or more ranged weapons on their wargear lists) can be equipped with a Poison Quiver & Bow.

rules.name: Repeater Crossbow
rules.description: Any fighter that can be equipped with a ranged weapon (they have access to one or more ranged weapons on their wargear lists) can be equipped with a Repeater Crossbow.

rules.name: Poison Needle
rules.description: Any *Leader* or *Champion* can be equipped with a Poison Needle.

rules.name: Dwarven Axe
rules.description: Any *Leader* or *Champion* can be equipped with a Dwarven Axe.

rules.name: Noble's Rapier
rules.description: Any *Leader* or *Champion* can be equipped with a Noble's Rapier.

rules.name: Black Flail
rules.description: Any *Leader* or *Champion* can be equipped with a Black Flail.

rules.name: Headsman's Axe
rules.description: Any *Leader* or *Champion* can be equipped with a Headsman's Axe.

rules.name: Halberd of the City
rules.description: Any *Leader* or *Champion* can be equipped with a Halberd of the City.

rules.name: Legendary Blade
rules.description: Any Leader or Champion can be equipped with a Legendary Blade.

rules.name: Rend
rules.description: Increase the Rend value by 1.

rules.name: Frenzied
rules.description: Add 3 to charge rolls for fighters equipped with this weapon.

rules.name: Shrouded
rules.description: Subtract 1 from melee attack rolls that target a fighter equipped with this weapon.

rules.name: Plaguewrought
rules.description: When making injury rolls for a fighter taken down with this weapon, they gain 1 level of Black Rot in addition to the injury roll.

rules.name: Attacks
rules.description: Increase the Attacks value to 4.

rules.name: Critical Damage
rules.description: Increase the Critical Damage value by 1.

rules.name: Pious
rules.description: A fighter cannot be poisoned while they are equipped with this weapon.

rules.name: Saint-blessed
rules.description: Each time a fighter equipped with this weapon activates, they can heal 1 life.

rules.description: Increase the Attacks value to 4.

rules.description: You can re-roll attack rolls of a natural 1 for attacks that target a *Wizard* or *Priest*.

rules.name: Soul-drinker
rules.description: Each time an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, the fighter equipped with this weapon heals 1 life.

rules.name: Exorcism
rules.description: You can re-roll attack rolls of a natural 1 for attacks that target an *Undead*.

rules.name: Demonsbane
rules.description: You can re-roll attack rolls of a natural 1 for attacks that target a *Demon*.

rules.name: Martyr
rules.description: If a fighter equipped with this weapon is taken down during a melee attack action, they are not taken down until the action ends and can continue to make attacks and parry.

rules.name: Peculiar Flask
rules.description:
The first time this fighter activates each battle, roll on the table opposite to determine which tonic the Wondrous Tonic becomes.
|d6|Peculiar Flask|
|---|:--|
|1|Tonic of Speed|
|2|Tonic of Strength|
|3|Tonic of Steady Aim|
|4|Tonic of Fortitude|
|5|Tonic of Mind|
|6|Tonic of Levitation|

rules.name: Blackrose Candle
rules.description: You can use this item in step 6 of the aftermath sequence. Pick a friendly fighter that has an **injury** and roll a dice. On a 2+ they no longer have that injury.

rules.name: Dwarven Whetstone
rules.description: At the start of each battle, pick a melee weapon a friendly fighter is armed with and roll a dice. On a 1, the whetstone has worn down, remove the Dwarven Whetstone from your stash. On a 2+, increase the Rend value of that weapon for the rest of the battle.

characteristics.$text:
Place the flame template. Each fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3+1|

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 15" of the caster, it then scatters d6".
Each fighter in its area is hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3+1|

After the attacks have been resolved, the blast template remains where it is. It represents a vortex that remains
in play until the end of the round.
Line of sight cannot be drawn across the vortex for fighters on the same elevation. In addition, fighters who start their activation within the vortex, or move across it, are hit with the same attack.
At the end of the round, remove the vortex.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 15" of the caster. That fighter has the *Will of the Saints* until the end of the round. While a fighter has the *Will of the Saints*, improve their Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: If critically cast, up to 2 friendly fighters can be picked instead of 1.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 15" of the caster, it then scatters d6".
Each fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the following successful attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3|


Then, the blast scatters d6" again, and every fighter in its areais targeted and hit with the above attack, (it is possible for the same fighter to be hit with an attack both times).

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: When the blast template is first placed, it does not scatter.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
The closest visible enemy fighter within 12" is targeted and hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3|


Then, pick another enemy fighter that is within 3" of the previous target and visible to it to be the new target. It is hit with the same attack.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: After the attack on the second target is resolved, pick another enemy fighter within 3" of the first two and visible to them, to be the third target. They are hit with the same attack.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Each friendly fighter within 3" of the caster heals 1 life.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Pick a visible enemy fighter within 12" of the caster to be the target. That enemy fighter is *doomed* . While an enemy fighter is *doomed* you can make them re-roll one of the following: an attack roll, a parry roll, an armour roll.
Once you do so, the fighter is no longer *doomed*.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a friendly fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target, then pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons to be *fetid* until the end of the round. While a weapon is *fetid* it gains the *Arcane* and *Poison* weapon traits.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the end of the round, the caster has a 6" aura of *shadows* Friendly fighters are in cover while they are within 6" of the caster.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the aura from 6" to 9".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 12" of the caster, it then scatters d6".
Each fighter in its area is hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-|d3|


Each fighter hit by the spell becomes *poisoned*, (see *Poison* weapon trait).

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the end of the round, the caster has a 6" aura of *rabid fervour*. Add 1 to attack rolls for melee attacks made by friendly fighters while they are within the aura.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the aura from 6" to 9".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 18" of the caster. That enemy fighter has *rotten armour* for the rest of the round. While a fighter has *rotten armour* worsen their Armour value by 1 (to a minimum of '-').

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The target fighter has *rotten armour* for the rest of the battle.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 3" of the caster, remove them from the battlefield and set them up again, anywhere on the battlefield within 9" of the caster and not engaged in melee, (if you pick the caster themselves, mark their location before removing them from the battlefield).

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range the fighter can be set up from 9" to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the flame template from the caster. Each fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the following successful attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|1|

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The Damage value is d3 instead of 1.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Place the blast template centred on the battlefield floor within 12" of the caster. Then scatter the blast template d6". You can pick d3 friendly fighters in Reserve to be set up on the battlefield floor, in the template and not engaged in melee.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the flame template from the caster. Each fighter in the template is targeted and hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3|

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Each fighter hit by the attack must pass a Willpower test else they become poisoned, (see the *Poison* weapon trait).

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible point on the battlefield floor within 6" of the caster. Until the end of the round, the battlefield floor within 6" of that point is a *mire*. Subtract 2 from the maximum distance a non-*Cloister* fighter can move each time they move across the mire.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The battlefield floor within 9" of that point is a *mire*, instead of 6".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a friendly *Demon* or *Beastman* fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target. That fighter has *demonic strength* until the end of the round. While a fighter has *demonic strength*, add 1 to the Damage and Critical Damage values of their Melee Weapons.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: You can pick 2 fighters to be targets instead of 1.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: The closest visible enemy fighter within 9" is targeted and suffers d3 damage. If they are not taken down, they must pass a Willpower test, else scatter d6".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a visible point on the battlefield floor within 9" of the caster. A pit opens here. In an order chosen by the commanding player of the caster, each fighter in the template is removed from the battlefield and set up again at the edge of the pit by its commanding player, not engaged in melee. If there is no space, they are set up as close to the edge of the pit as possible, not engaged in melee.
After being set up, the fighter must pass an Initiative test else suffer d3 damage and become *poisoned* (see the *Poison* weapon trait).
The pit remains in play until the end of the round. Fighters cannot move across the pit while they are on the battlefield floor. Any treasure tokens on the pit are destroyed.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Place the blast template centred on a point within 15" of the caster. Each enemy fighter in the template is targeted and must pass a Willpower test else they become *poisoned*, (see the *Poison* weapon trait).

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Subtract 1 from any Willpower tests made for this spell.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a friendly *Demon* or *Beastman* fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target. That fighter has a *protective shroud* until the end of the round. While a fighter has *protective shroud*, improve their Armour value by 1.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a friendly fighter within 6" of the casting fighter to be the target,. That fighter has a *putrid blessing* until the end of the round. While a fighter has a *putrid blessing*, their Melee Weapons gain the *Arcane* and *Poison* weapon traits.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a point within 12" of the caster, it then scatters d6".
Each fighter in the template is targeted and heals d3 life.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: The closest visible enemy fighter within 9" is targeted and suffers 1 damage. If they are not taken down, they have *rotten insides*. While a fighter has *rotten insides* their Move value is 2". At the end of their activation, a fighter with *rotten insides* takes a Willpower test. If they pass, they no longer have rotten insides.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
A *summoned* Rotling fighter, is added to the caster's warband until it is taken down. Set up the fighter within 3" of the caster and not engaged in melee.
A warband cannot have more than 3 *summoned* fighters at any time. If the caster's warband already has 3 *summoned* fighters, they cannot cast this spell.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The fighter can be set up within 9" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 9" of the caster to be the target. That fighter is *swollen* until the end of the round. While a fighter is *swollen*, they can ignore the first 3 points of damage they suffer.

rules.name: Alchemist's Fire
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make a ranged attack action with the following weapon:
|Range|Attacks|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|---|---|:--|
|Flame|1|-|d3|-|Flame, Scare|

rules.name: Blinding Powder
rules.description:
While this fighter is engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Throw Powder [Bonus Action]**: Pick an enemy fighter engaged in melee with this fighter and roll a dice. On a 2+, that fighter is *blinded* until the end of the activation. While a fighter is *blinded*, subtract 1 from their attack rolls.

rules.name: Book of Funeral Rites
rules.description: Each time another friendly fighter is killed, this fighter earns 5 bonus experience.

rules.name: Dwarven Bomb
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make a ranged attack action with the following weapon:
|Range|Attacks|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|---|---|:--|
|8"|1|-1|d3+1|-|Blast|

rules.name: Etched Silver Bullets
rules.description:
The item has 3+d3 silver bullets. Keep track of how many remain during the campaign. While a fighter is equipped with this item and is equipped with an eligible weapon (see below), they can use 1 silver bullet to make the bonus action below. The item is removed when no silver bullets remain.
**Eligible weapons**: *Blackpowder Pistol, Blackpowder Rifle, Brace of Pistols, Heirloom Duelling Pistol, Long Rifle, Repeater Pistol*.
**Load Silver Bullet [Bonus Action]**: For the next ranged attack this fighter makes this activation with an eligible weapon the following applies:
- Improve the Rend value by 1.
- It has the Arcane weapon trait.

rules.name: Gunsmith's Kit
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Unclog [Bonus Action]**: Pick a weapon the fighter is armed with that has suffered the 'Clogged' result on the misfire table. That weapon is no longer clogged and can be used to make attacks with once more.

rules.name: Healing Tonic
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]**: Heal this fighter d6 life.

rules.name: Ivory Memento Mori
rules.description: The next time an injury roll for this fighter is 'killed', you can treat the injury roll as 'full recovery'. Then, this item is removed.

rules.name: Vial of Poison
rules.description:
While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:
**Apply Poison [Bonus Action]**: Pick 1 of this fighter's melee weapons, for the rest of the battle it has the *Poison* weapon trait.

rules.name: Writ of Sorcery
rules.description: When a fighter is given this item, pick one of your faction's spell lores and randomly determine a spell from it. The fighter can use an Arcane Action to cast this spell even if they are not a *Wizard* or *Priest*. In addition, do not make a casting roll. Instead roll a dice: On a 1, the spell miscasts, on a 2-5 it casts, and on a 6 it critically casts.

rules.name: Blackrose Balm
rules.description: You can use this item in step 6 of the aftermath sequence. Pick a friendly fighter that has a temporary injury and roll a dice. On a 2+ they no longer have that temporary injury.

rules.name: Jar of Canal Leeches
rules.description: This item can be used to leech blood.

rules.name: Physician's Kit
rules.description: You can use this item after making an injury roll for a friendly fighter. Re-roll the injury roll.

rules.name: Treasure Map
rules.description:
You can use this item when exploring the City. Instead of making an exploration roll, roll on the table below:
|d6|Treasure Map|
|---|:--|
|1|**Forgery**: After circling for hours, you conclude this map leads nowhere. You find nothing.|
|2+|**X Marks the Spot**: You receive 3d6x5 silver. In addition, roll once on the **Relics table**.|

rules.name: Ancient Banner
rules.description:
While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.
You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

rules.name: Bestial Companion
rules.description:
Each time this fighter makes a melee attack, they can make 1 additional attack with the following weapon:
|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|:--|
|-1|2|d3+1|Natural Weapon|

rules.name: Spirit Guardian
rules.description:
Once per battle this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Invoke Ethereal Protection [Bonus Action]**: Until the end of the round, this fighter ignores Rend for attacks that target them. In addition, each time they make a successful armour roll against a melee attack, the attacking fighters suffers 1 damage.

rules.name: Winged Familiar
rules.description:
Once per battle fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Harry [Bonus Action]**: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 24". Until the end of the round, that enemy fighter is *harried*. While a fighter is *harried*, each time they make a Move or Action they must pass a Willpower test, else they lose that Move or Action.

characteristics.name: Weapon Traits
characteristics.$text: Arcane, Heavy, Misfire, Rare 0-1, Two-handed, Volley

rules.name: Bomb Rat
rules.description:
Once per battle, while this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can make the following bonus action:
**Set Up Bomb Rat [Bonus Action]:** A Giant Rat is summoned and added to the commanding player's warband. Set up the Giant Rat fighter within 3" of the fighter and choose a number between 1 and 6. This number is the **fuse length**. Use a dice placed next to the Giant Rat to track the fuse length.
Each time that Giant Rat activates, roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the fuse length, the bomb detonates. If the roll is equal or less than than the fuse length, the Giant Rat is activated as normal and the fuse length is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).
When the bomb detonates, the blast template is centred on the Giant Rat. Each other fighter in the template it is hit with the following attack, then the
Giant Rat is taken down (it does not count towards flee tests):
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-2|d3|


If the Giant Rat is taken down and the bomb has not yet detonated, roll a dice as above to see if it detonates or not.

rules.name: Gas Mask
rules.description: This fighter cannot be *poisoned*.

rules.name: Heavy Plating
rules.description:
*Armour value (5+)*
Subtract 1 from the Move value of fighters equipped with this armour.

rules.name: Net
rules.description:
Once per battle, at the start of a melee attack action in which this fighter is either the attacking or defending fighter, they can throw the net. To do so, they take an Initiative test. If passed, the enemy fighter becomes
entwined.
While a fighter is entwined, subtract 1 from the Attacks value of their melee weapons (off-hand attacks are unaffected). Each time an entwined fighter is activated, they can take an Initiative test, if passed, they are no longer entwined.

rules.name: Periscope
rules.description: While this fighter hasn't made a move in the same activation, add 5" to the Range value of their two-handed ranged weapons (excluding those with the *Flame* weapon trait).

characteristics.name: Weapon Traits
characteristics.$text: Blast, Heavy, Misfire, One-use, Rare 0-1, Two-handed

rules.name: Smoke Bomb
rules.description:
Once per battle, while this fighter is engaged in melee, they can use the following bonus action:
**Drop Smoke Bomb [Bonus Action]**: Remove this fighter from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of its previous position and not engaged in melee.

rules.name: Wheel Spikes
rules.description: Improve the Rend value by 1 on this fighter's Crushing Bulk melee weapon and the attack dealt by the 'Splat!' special rule.

rules.name: Clan Banner
rules.description:
While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.
You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

rules.name: Bomb-bolt
rules.description:
This item requires the fighter to be equipped with a Crossbow.
Once per battle, when this fighter can make a Ranged Attack action with the following weapon:
|Range|Attacks|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|---|---|:--|
|20"|1|-1|d3+1|-|*Blast*|

rules.name: Guild Banner
rules.description:
While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.
You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

rules.name: Loyal Companion
rules.description:
Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, they can make 1 additional attack with the following weapon:
|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|:--|
|-1|1|d3|Natural Weapon|

rules.name: Ogre Armour
rules.description: *Armour value 5+*

rules.name: Torchlight/Lantern
rules.description: Worsen the Armour value of enemy *Demon* and *Undead* fighters by 1 while they are engaged with any fighters equipped with this item.

rules.name: Wooden Stakes
rules.description:
Once per battle, while this fighter is engaged in melee with a *Undead* or *Demon* fighter that is bloodied, it can use the following bonus action:
**Drive the Stake [Bonus Action]**: Pick an enemy *Demon* or *Undead* fighter this fighter is engaged in melee with, that is bloodied, to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+ the target is immediately taken down. In the aftermath of battle, this fighter earns 10 bonus experience.

rules.name: Cauldron
rules.description: **[Action]** This fighter can use this item as an action. The fighter takes a Willpower test. If they pass, pick a spell from a spell lore they know to be prepared.

rules.name: Cloister Icon
rules.description:
While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.
You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

rules.name: Demonic Familiar
rules.description:
Each time this fighter makes a melee attack, they can make 1 additional attack with the following weapon:
|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|:--|
|-|1|d3|Arcane, Natural Weapon, Poison|

rules.name: Gut Wound
rules.description: Halve the fighter's Life value (rounding up).

rules.name: Blinded In One Eye
rules.description: The fighter’s Bow value is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Fractured Arm
rules.description: The fighter’s Blade value is reduced by 1.

rules.name: Broken Leg
rules.description: Halve the fighter's Move value (rounding up).

rules.name: Head Injury
rules.description: Halve the fighter's Initiative value (rounding up).

rules.name: Frayed Nerves
rules.description: Halve the fighter's Willpower value (rounding up).
